:::{#def-sequence}
#### Sequence

A **sequence** in a set $S$
[@wikipedia_sequence]
is a [function](#def-function) $a : \Nat \to S$
from the [natural numbers](number-systems.qmd#def-natural-numbers) to $S$.
Its value $a(n)$ is written $a_n$,
and the sequence is written $(a_n)$ or $a_1, a_2, a_3, \ldots$.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#def-sequence-term}
#### Term of a sequence

The value $a_n$ of a sequence $(a_n)$ (@def-sequence) is called its $n$th **term**.

:::
